en.title: I tried reusing the work actually done with the AI ​​agent "Hermes Agent" that grows as you use it as a skill

Hermes Agent has a function that allows you to save actual work steps and troubleshooting methods as "skills" and reuse them in other sessions. Therefore, this time, we will actually develop a skill for the series of tasks we did last time, ``Searching for articles from GIGAZINE and summarizing the contents,'' and how we will utilize our previous experience when asked to perform similar tasks in a new session.

en.title: A campaign asking people not to copy and paste answers from AI: “Don’t paste the AI, please.”
en.summary: AI such as ChatGPT cannot confirm the correctness or authenticity of the sentences it outputs due to its mechanism. Even if it looks like it's done, it's actually not, so humans ultimately need to confirm its accuracy. However, there are people who are unaware of this mechanism and simply copy and paste sentences generated by AI, creating an unnecessary burden on those who receive such sentences as they must first check whether the sentences are correct. There is a campaign calling for an end to such ``copying and pasting AI text verbatim''. read more...
